input:
Camera preview stutters to ~10 fps whenever a GPU-intensive game is running in the background on our MT6989 device. When the game is not running, preview is smooth at 30 fps. Relevant ftrace output:

  mali0-3      [003] d... 4521.113: mali_dvfs_set_freq: util=91% new_freq=848000
  v4l2-cap0    [001] d... 4521.119: dma_fence_wait: fence=stream:1041 wait=18ms
  mali0-3      [003] d... 4521.121: mali_dvfs_set_freq: util=97% new_freq=1024000
  v4l2-cap0    [001] d... 4521.138: dma_fence_wait: fence=stream:1042 wait=36ms TIMEOUT

The fence wait timeout on the ISP output buffer is 36 ms, which pushes past our 33 ms frame deadline. I suspect DMA-BUF fence contention between the Mali GPU and the ISP, but I'm not sure whether the bottleneck is DVFS latency, bandwidth saturation, or fence dependency ordering. How should I approach this?
